title: Water Shutoff Notice
body: Water supply will be temporarily shut off for routine plumbing maintenance tomorrow between 10:00 AM and 2:00 PM.

title: Annual Summer Resident Gathering
body: The annual community gathering is taking place this Saturday at the rooftop terrace and BBQ pavilion. Refreshments provided!

title: Fire Alarm & Sprinkler Testing
body: Contractors will be testing common area sounders and smoke dampers between 9:00 AM and 12:00 PM. No evacuation required.
